artifacts.claim: The project has a Next.js/PWA Web application, NestJS API, and shared packages.
The complete adoption process and authentication are outside the first iteration.
Animal defines AVAILABLE, IN_TREATMENT, IN_ADOPTION_PROCESS, and ADOPTED.
Current code does not encode permitted Animal status transitions.
The public detail page contains a future-interest link but no implemented form.
The API exposes only Animals endpoints.
Adoptant and AdoptionInterest are planned future concepts related to Animal.
Layer responsibilities are separated and domain is framework-independent.
Relevant architectural changes require versioned documentation and reusable prompts.
Interest registration, adopter registration, and initial screening are planned for a later adoption prototype.
The current system has public Animal data but no applicant-data model or staff-review UI/API.
Only initial interest is in scope; the complete adoption process is not.
Any introduced applicant data must remain outside public animal-profile responses.
A proposal must expose, rather than assume, a status-transition policy.
Consent, retention, duplicate-interest, and API privacy checks require validation.
